The petitioners are before this Court calling in question registration of a crime in Crime No.461/2013 and filing of the charge sheet in C.C.No.12780/2014, pending before the VIII ACMM,
Bengaluru, registered for the offences under Sections 498A, 506 of the IPC and Sections 3 and 4 of the Dowry Prohibition Act, 1961.

2. Though the challenge is made to the proceedings before the concerned Court, learned counsel for the petitioner restricts his prayer seeking a direction to the concerned Court NC: 2024:KHC:19367 to conclude the proceedings within a time frame.
It is his submission that despite the matter is 11 years old, the concerned Court has not concluded the matter on account of the complainant not appearing and tendering evidence.

3. In that light and also the fact that the matter is pending for the last 11 years, I deem it appropriate to direct the concerned Court to conclude the proceedings, within an outer limit of 4 months, if not earlier.
4. With the aforesaid direction, the criminal petition stands disposed.
